title: Application Behavior & Human Assurance
description: Human verification rules for ASVS requirements that cannot be concluded reliably from unattended CLI evidence.

rules.title: ASVS 2.1.1 Input validation rules are documented

args.review: Human assessment scope: The application's documentation defines input validation rules for how to check the validity of data items against an expected structure. This could be common data formats such as credit card numbers, email addresses, telephone numbers, or it could be an internal data format.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 2.3.1 Business workflows enforce the required sequence

args.review: Human assessment scope: The application will only process business logic flows for the same user in the expected sequential step order and without skipping steps.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 6.1.1 Anti-automation policy is documented

args.review: Human assessment scope: Application documentation defines how controls such as rate limiting, anti-automation, and adaptive response, are used to defend against attacks such as credential stuffing and password brute force. The documentation must make clear how these controls are configured and prevent malicious account lockout.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 6.2.2 Users can change their password

args.review: Human assessment scope: Users can change their password.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 6.2.3 Password changes require the current password

args.review: Human assessment scope: Password change functionality requires the user's current and new password.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 6.2.5 Password policy does not impose composition rules

args.review: Human assessment scope: Passwords of any composition can be used, without rules limiting the type of characters permitted. There must be no requirement for a minimum number of upper or lower case characters, numbers, or special characters.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 6.2.6 Password entry is masked

args.review: Human assessment scope: Password input fields use type=password to mask the entry. Applications may allow the user to temporarily view the entire masked password, or the last typed character of the password.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 6.2.7 Password managers and paste are allowed

args.review: Human assessment scope: "paste"functionality, browser password helpers, and external password managers are permitted.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 6.2.8 Password verification preserves the exact input

args.review: Human assessment scope: The application verifies the user's password exactly as received from the user, without any modifications such as truncation or case transformation.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 6.4.1 Initial credentials are random, short-lived, and replaced

args.review: Human assessment scope: System generated initial passwords or activation codes are securely randomly generated, follow the existing password policy, and expire after a short period of time or after they are initially used. These initial secrets must not be permitted to become the long term password.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 6.4.2 Password hints and secret questions are not used

args.review: Human assessment scope: Password hints or knowledge-based authentication (so-called "secret questions") are not present.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 7.2.1 Sessions are validated by a trusted backend

args.review: Human assessment scope: The application performs all session token verification using a trusted, backend service.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 7.2.2 Session tokens are dynamically generated

args.review: Human assessment scope: The application uses either self-contained or reference tokens that are dynamically generated for session management, i.e. not using static API secrets and keys.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 7.2.3 Reference session tokens have at least 128 bits of entropy

args.review: Human assessment scope: If reference tokens are used to represent user sessions, they are unique and generated using a cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generator (CSPRNG) and possess at least 128 bits of entropy.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 7.2.4 Session tokens rotate after authentication

args.review: Human assessment scope: The application generates a new session token on user authentication, including re-authentication, and terminates the current session token.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 7.4.1 Logout and expiry terminate sessions

args.review: Human assessment scope: When session termination is triggered (such as logout or expiration), the application disallows any further use of the session. For reference tokens or stateful sessions, this means invalidating the session data at the application backend. Applications using self-contained tokens will need a solution such as maintaining a list of terminated tokens, disallowing tokens produced before a per-user date and time or rotating a per-user signing key.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 7.4.2 Disabled accounts lose all active sessions

args.review: Human assessment scope: The application terminates all active sessions when a user account is disabled or deleted (such as an employee leaving the company).

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 8.1.1 Authorization rules are documented

args.review: Human assessment scope: Authorization documentation defines rules for restricting function-level and data-specific access based on consumer permissions and resource attributes.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 8.2.2 Object-level authorization prevents IDOR and BOLA

args.review: Human assessment scope: The application ensures that data-specific access is restricted to consumers with explicit permissions to specific data items to mitigate insecure direct object reference (IDOR) and broken object level authorization (BOLA).

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 8.3.1 Authorization is enforced by a trusted service layer

args.review: Human assessment scope: The application enforces authorization rules at a trusted service layer and doesn't rely on controls that an untrusted consumer could manipulate, such as client-side JavaScript.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 10.4.1 OAuth redirect URIs are exactly matched

args.review: Human assessment scope: The authorization server validates redirect URIs based on a client-specific allowlist of pre-registered URIs using exact string comparison.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 10.4.2 OAuth authorization codes are single-use

args.review: Human assessment scope: If the authorization server returns the authorization code in the authorization response, it can be used only once for a token request. For the second valid request with an authorization code that has already been used to issue an access token, the authorization server must reject a token request and revoke any issued tokens related to the authorization code.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 10.4.3 OAuth authorization codes expire within ten minutes

args.review: Human assessment scope: The authorization code is short-lived. The maximum lifetime can be up to 10 minutes for L1 and L2 applications and up to 1 minute for L3 applications.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 10.4.4 OAuth grants are restricted per client

args.review: Human assessment scope: For a given client, the authorization server only allows the usage of grants that this client needs to use. Note that the grants 'token'(Implicit flow) and 'password'(Resource Owner Password Credentials flow) must no longer be used.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 10.4.5 Public clients have refresh-token replay protection

args.review: Human assessment scope: The authorization server mitigates refresh token replay attacks for public clients, preferably using sender-constrained refresh tokens, i.e., Demonstrating Proof of Possession (DPoP) or Certificate-Bound Access Tokens using mutual TLS (mTLS). For L1 and L2 applications, refresh token rotation may be used. If refresh token rotation is used, the authorization server must invalidate the refresh token after usage, and revoke all refresh tokens for that authorization if an already used and invalidated refresh token is provided.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 14.3.1 Authenticated client-side data is cleared on session end

args.review: Human assessment scope: Authenticated data is cleared from client storage, such as the browser DOM, after the client or session is terminated. The 'Clear-Site-Data' HTTP response header field may be able to help with this but the client-side should also be able to clear up if the server connection is not available when the session is terminated.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 15.1.1 Dependency remediation deadlines are documented

args.review: Human assessment scope: Application documentation defines risk based remediation time frames for 3rd party component versions with vulnerabilities and for updating libraries in general, to minimize the risk from these components.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 15.3.1 Responses return only required fields

args.review: Human assessment scope: The application only returns the required subset of fields from a data object. For example, it should not return an entire data object, as some individual fields should not be accessible to users.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.
